name: callback-unavailable-time
lines: I'd rather just talk to someone from the team, can they call me back?
Monday at 8 PM works for me, I'm in Eastern time.
Oh okay. Then the latest slot you have that day is fine. My number is 555 010 0177 and my name is Priya Natarajan.
expect: The agent says plainly that Monday 8 PM Eastern is outside the team's callback hours, states the hours, then offers the nearest open times; it never presents a different time as if it were the requested one, and confirms only after reserve_callback returns ok.
